scope: All 86 exact approved current V3 Human profiles: 48 draft ranks and 38 champion profiles including shared Lady Claire.
method: Decode exact approved packed GLBs with the native test GLTF loader, sample actual Idle at t=0, measure precise skinned-mesh world bounds, compose current classification × family presentation × 0.704 battlefield factors. Full silhouette and semantic garment/headwear body proxy reported separately.
limits: Garment/headwear body bounds are a semantic proxy, not manually annotated anatomical head height. Full bounds include weapons, magic and wings.
No shaded same-camera contact sheet was generated. Source portrait crops are not evidence of battlefield size.
Read-only analysis; no runtime, model, gallery or approval data was edited.
